subdomains.name: Jungle Domain
subdomains.benefit: Gain Jungle terrain-domain powers and spells.

powers.name: Brachiation
powers.summary: As a free action for rounds per day equal to druid level, gain a climb speed equal to land speed and add druid level to Acrobatics checks.

powers.name: Trap Sense
powers.summary: Gain trap sense as a rogue of your druid level; bonuses from multiple classes stack.

subdomains.name: Swamp Domain
subdomains.benefit: Gain Swamp terrain-domain powers and spells.

powers.name: Natural Healing
powers.summary: Channel energy as a cleric of your druid level 3 + Charisma modifier times per day, only to heal animals, plants, and vermin; trade healing dice for ability-damage recovery.

powers.name: Reed Hunter
powers.summary: Gain blindsense 30 feet against concealment and cover from fog, vegetation, or water; this becomes blindsight at 12th level.
